title: Cantilever column, buckling
description: Steel bar 200 x 20 x 20 mm, end x = 0 fixed, 1000 N axial compression (-x) on the free end. Critical load = load factor x 1000 N.

quantities.label: Euler buckling load, mode 1
quantities.formula: pi^2 E I / (4 L^2) (fixed-free column, effective length 2 L)
quantities.citation: Timoshenko & Gere, Theory of Elastic Stability, 2nd ed., McGraw-Hill 1961, Section 2.1 (Euler), Section 2.17 (Engesser shear correction P = Pe / (1 + Pe/(kGA)))
quantities.tolerance_reason: The shear correction lowers P slightly (seen: -0.31 %); 5 % covers it and the mesh.
